title: MENTOR: Reinforcement Learning via Flexible Teacher-Optimized Rewards for Tool-Use Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2510.18383v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Distilling the tool-use capabilities of large language models (LLMs) into small language models (SLMs) is essential for their practical application. The predominant approach, supervised fine-tuning (SFT), is an off-policy distillation method that suffers from poor out-of-domain (OOD) generalization because it rigidly aligns with static teacher trajectories. While reinforcement learning (RL) offers an alternative, the capacity limitations of SLMs pose a severe dilemma: sparse outcome rewards provide insufficient guidance, whereas strict trajectory matching imposes overly restrictive constraints. To bridge this capacity-driven gap, we propose MENTOR, an on-policy distillation framework that introduces a flexible yet process-aware reward structure. Instead of enforcing rigid replication, MENTOR uses the teacher's reference to guide tool-use behavior, balancing behavioral alignment with downstream performance. Extensive experiments

translated_title: MENTOR：通过灵活的教师优化奖励进行工具使用蒸馏的强化学习
translated_abstract: 将大型语言模型（LLMs）的工具使用能力蒸馏到小型语言模型（SLMs）中，对于其实际应用至关重要。主流方法监督微调（SFT）是一种离策略蒸馏方法，由于它僵硬地与静态教师轨迹对齐，导致其在域外（OOD）泛化方面表现不佳。虽然强化学习（RL）提供了一种替代方案，但SLMs的能力限制带来了严峻的困境：稀疏的结果奖励提供的指导不足，而严格的轨迹匹配则施加了过于严格的约束。为了弥合这一能力驱动的差距，我们提出了MENTOR，一种在策略蒸馏框架，引入了灵活且过程感知的奖励结构。MENTOR不强制僵硬的复制，而是利用教师的参考来引导工具使用行为，在行为对齐与下游性能之间取得平衡。大量实验表明...
tldr: 本文提出MENTOR，一种基于强化学习的在策略蒸馏框架，通过灵活且过程感知的奖励结构，在行为对齐和性能之间取得平衡，有效解决了将大型语言模型工具使用能力蒸馏到小型模型时的域外泛化问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MENTOR, an on-policy distillation framework using flexible and process-aware rewards to balance behavioral alignment and performance, effectively addressing out-of-domain generalization issues when distilling tool-use capabilities from large to small language models.
